Company overview

Orbiss Inc. is a tax and accounting firm specializing in business growth in the United States. Launched in 2020, Orbiss has helped hundreds of small and medium-sized international companies scale up and thrive in the dynamic American market.

With a focus on personalized solutions, Orbiss offers fully tailored support for our clients’ cross-border tax, accounting, and consulting needs. Our vision is modernity, driving us to adopt an innovative approach that prioritizes process automation and quality assurance, while always keeping people at the heart of our mission.

At its core, Orbiss is an innovative, modern, young firm that believes an old industry can still learn new tricks. We prioritize the development of our people and are dedicated to guiding you through the learning process.

As a Senior Tax Consultant, you will be responsible for:

Tax Advisory & Planning Support
•	Design and lead comprehensive U.S. and international tax planning strategies to High-net worth individuals and business structures.
•	Lead cross-border reorganizations analyses and permanent establishment assessments.
•	Provide senior-level guidance on tax treaty applications, FATCA, PFIC and CFC/GILTI regimes.
•	Conduct detailed tax research and prepare technical memos on U.S. and international tax topics.
•	Support the preparation of advisory deliverables related to personal and corporate structuring, and tax optimization.


Equity Compensation & Stock Options
•	Advise U.S. and foreign clients on the design and tax treatment of equity compensation plans like ISO vs. NSO stock options, RSUs....
•	Analyze cross-border stock option taxation, including sourcing issues for global mobility employees and executives, and tax opportunities.
•	Support clients in structuring 83(b) elections, AMT exposure and QSBS qualifications.
•	Coordinate with legal counsel on equity plan documentation for international founders.

Client Relationship Management
•	Own a portfolio of senior client relationships, serving as the main point of contact for tax matters throughout the fiscal year.
•	Deliver clear, actionable advice on complex tax issues to C-suite executives, founders, and general counsel.
•	Lead or co-lead client presentations, strategy sessions, and annual tax planning meetings.
•	Advise tax strategies for wealth transfer, estate planning, and cross-jurisdictional compliance.


Compliance Oversight
•	Review and sign off on federal and state income tax returns, and international filings (5471, 5472, 8858, 8865).
•	Monitor legislative and regulatory developments (IRS, Treasury Reg.) and translate their impact for clients in practical terms.

Team Leadership & Thought Leadership
•	Contribute to internal knowledge-sharing initiatives, technical memos, and client-facing educational content.

Business Support
•	Drive business development through proposals, speaking engagements, and thought leadership content; collaborate with senior partners on strategic client initiatives.

246330.missionDescription:
About the job

As Supply Chain Specialist VIE within our Manufacturing & Supply team, you’ll act as the primary Supply Chain focal point for all products manufactured by CMOs, ensuring seamless integration between internal stakeholders and external manufacturing partners.

Join a global network that powers how Sanofi delivers — seamlessly, purposefully, and at scale. In Manufacturing & Supply, you’ll help reimagine how life-changing treatments reach people everywhere, faster.  

Ready to get started?

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. 

Main responsibilities:

Strategic Supply Chain Management
- Design and implement supply strategies that balance service levels, inventory optimization, and cost efficiency in alignment with corporate policies.
- Lead the development of mid to long-term supply plans, anticipating market trends, demand fluctuations, and capacity constraints.
- Drive strategic initiatives to enhance supply chain resilience and mitigate risks across the CMO network.
 
Inventory & Service Level Optimization
- Monitor and ensure optimal stock levels in accordance with current inventory policies, preventing stockouts and excess inventory situations.
- Establish and maintain target service levels, working proactively to achieve KPIs and minimize business disruption.
- Develop advanced analytics and forecasting models to improve demand planning accuracy and inventory turnover.
- Lead cross-functional teams in developing action plans to reduce product destruction and manage materials with short shelf life.
 
Procurement & Supplier Management
- Manage the placement and tracking of purchase orders with CMOs, ensuring alignment with supply chain planning tools and business requirements.
- Monitor delivery fulfillment through systematic supplier performance tracking, ensuring on-time and in-full (OTIF) delivery compliance.
- Assess and manage risks of contractual penalties related to OTIF performance, implementing corrective actions as needed.
- Ensure CMO compliance with all contractual clauses, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
- Support periodic reviews of Service Level Agreements (SLAs), analyzing demand patterns and optimizing parameters such as MOQ, lead times, and minimum shelf life requirements.
 
New Product Introduction & Lifecycle Management
- Oversee supply chain activities for New Product Launches (NPL), ensuring timely market availability and successful commercialization.
- Collaborate with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial teams to develop robust supply plans for product introductions.
- Follow artwork changes and updates between CMOs and internal teams, ensuring regulatory compliance and technical accuracy.
- Support product lifecycle management initiatives, including phase-ins, phase-outs, and portfolio optimization.
 
Performance Management & Continuous Improvement
Develop, track, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) for CMO performance, including OTIF, lead time compliance, and quality metrics.
Conduct monthly performance reviews with CMOs, identifying gaps, opportunities for improvement, and implementing corrective actions.
Ensure implementation/participation in Supply Chain Projects as a KU for a period.
Create plans for improvement with multifunctional team, when the process is putting the business in risk.
 
Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Management (New/Enhanced)
- Lead functional meetings with Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Logistics, Warehousing, Commercial, and COMEX teams to ensure end-to-end supply chain visibility.
- Serve as the escalation point for supply chain issues, coordinating rapid response and resolution across internal and external stakeholders.
- Mentor and provide guidance to junior supply chain analysts, fostering skill development and knowledge sharing.
- Represent Supply Chain in strategic business reviews, presenting insights, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with CMO leadership to drive collaboration and strategic alignment.

Risk Management & Business Continuity 
- Proactively identify and assess supply chain risks (capacity constraints, quality issues, geopolitical factors) and develop mitigation strategies.
- Manage crisis situations and supply disruptions, coordinating with global teams to minimize business impact.
- Ensure timely communication of quality-related supply issues to global Quality teams for escalation and resolution.
- Develop contingency plans and alternative sourcing strategies to ensure business continuity.
 
Compliance, Ethics & Corporate Responsibility
- Maintain comprehensive knowledge of and ensure compliance with Sanofi's Ethics and Integrity principles, policies, and codes of conduct.
- Comply with and promote Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies to prevent accidents, mitigate health risks, and reduce environmental impact.
- Support and champion Sanofi's Diversity and Inclusion initiatives, ensuring respectful treatment and equal opportunities for all employees and partners.
- Ensure all supply chain activities comply with pharmaceutical industry regulations and quality standards.

Why choose us?

- Be part of a pioneering biopharma company where patient insights shape drug development.
- Work at the forefront of AI-powered science that accelerates discovery and improves outcomes.
- Collaborate beyond your expertise, sparking new ideas with diverse, multidisciplinary teams.
- Work at the forefront of drug discovery, harnessing cutting-edge AI, data, and digital platforms to push the boundaries of science.
- Help improve the lives of millions of people globally by making drug development quicker and more effective.
- Join a workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core, with Employee Resource Groups and leadership programs that celebrate every voice.

iMove is a unique program tailored for European youth interested in challenging themselves with meaningful assignments across the globe. At Sanofi we have a strong ambition to invest in young talents who will drive the success of Sanofi tomorrow.

Sanofi’s Work Abroad Program, iMove, offers jobs-assignments with actual responsibilities and a perspective to grow. We provide those opportunities in various functions such as: marketing, finance, regulatory, supply chain, clinical trials, production, etc. and in more than 40 countries. Sanofi unites people who are passionate about solving healthcare needs across the world. Joining our iMove Work Abroad Program is a unique opportunity to make a difference through your work.

Pursue Progress. Discover Extraordinary.

Progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. You can be one of those people. Chasing change, embracing new ideas and exploring all the opportunities we have to offer. Let’s pursue progress. And let’s discover extraordinary together.

At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity. 

Watch our ALL IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com!

246312.missionDescription:
Context:
SMS-E (Sumitomo Materials Solution Europe) is a leader in the development and manufacturing of laser annealing equipment for the semiconductor industry. SMS-E laser products are used across a wide range of semiconductor technologies (CMOS, DRAM, IGBT, etc.) and are widely adopted by the world’s leading chip makers.
Role Overview:
As an Application / Process Engineer, you will act as the key technical interface between our equipment and client fab teams. You will help chip makers integrate and develop new processes on our tools, optimizing performance while ensuring process reliability and quality. You will report directly to the Product and Application Manager based in Gennevilliers, France.
Key Responsibilities:
•	Collaborate with customers to understand their process goals and requirements.
•	Develop, test, and optimize semiconductor processes using our laser annealing equipment.
•	Provide advanced process support during equipment integration and qualification (acceptance).
•	Analyze process data and propose solutions to improve performance and yield.
•	Conduct technical demonstrations, training sessions, and workshops for customers, with daily interaction on-site.
•	Prepare and deliver regular technical reports to SMS-E management.
•	Collaborate with other SMS-E departments (Maintenance, R&D, Sales, etc.) to ensure successful integration of our laser products at customer sites.
Required Qualifications:
•	Master’s or PhD degree in Semiconductors, Chemical Engineering, Electronics, or Material Science.
•	Knowledge of the semiconductor industry and related processes is preferred.
•	Experience in designing experimental plans (DOE).
•	Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret experimental data.
•	Experience in customer management and technical support.
•	Fluent in English; Mandarin is a plus.
•	Team player with excellent communication skills.
Position Specifics:
•	Based in Hsinchu, Taiwan at our subsidiary office.
•	Up to 25% travel (mainly within Asia: Japan, China, Singapore, Malaysia).
•	Work in a cleanroom environment.
•	Strict adherence to customer IP rules.

Within the AI & Data Business Unit, you will help organizations transform their business processes through Generative and Agentic AI. Working alongside Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Solution Architects, and Platform Engineers, and working step-by-step with customers, you will design, build, and deploy enterprise-grade AI systems that create measurable business value. Your key responsibilities include:  

Assist the GenAI Solution Architect in designing scalable and secure AI solutions.  

Develop applications powered by foundation models, both self-managed and API-accessible, that meet business needs and comply with applicable regulations (GDPR, EU AI Act, model licenses, etc.).  

Design prompting and orchestration strategies to improve reasoning, controllability, reliability, and user experience.  

Design and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems leveraging enterprise knowledge sources, semantic search, and source attribution.  

Design, implement, and optimize agentic AI systems using orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.  

Develop AI agents capable of tool usage, workflow orchestration, planning, reasoning, memory management, and human-in-the-loop interactions.  

Architect AI solutions integrating enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and knowledge repositories.  

Evaluate and select the most appropriate models based on business requirements, performance, latency, and cost constraints.  

Monitor AI system performance in production and contribute to observability, evaluation, and governance practices.  

Conduct research on the latest advances in foundation models, multimodal AI, and agentic AI systems.

Finally, are you curious and enjoy working as part of a team? Do you want to join a dynamic and motivating professional environment? Do you share our values of excellence, entrepreneurship, innovation, sharing, kindness, and work-life balance?  

Are you fluent in English?  

Then join us!

Eurofins is an international network of independent life sciences companies, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. The Eurofins network is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across its companies around the world.

Job Description

Are you eager to kick-start your career in Learning & Development while developing strong project management skills in a global environment? As a Junior Project Coordinator, you will help create impactful digital learning experiences that support colleagues across the international Eurofins network. This is an exciting opportunity to gain exposure to global projects while developing expertise in digital learning and stakeholder collaboration. 

In this role, you will: 

Lead the coordination of learning initiatives, managing timelines, stakeholders, and project delivery to ensure the successful development and deployment of engaging training solutions. 

Design and develop engaging e-learning courses, following established learning standards and internal processes. 

Create supporting learning materials such as user guides, quick reference guides, manuals and handouts. 

Update and implement multilingual versions of e-learning courses using translation resources. 

Contribute to the ongoing improvement of learning content, processes and the overall learner experience across the Eurofins network. 

We’re looking for a permanent candidate or V.I.E candidate. 

Interested in an international opportunity? 

We are open to both permanent employees and candidates eligible for the V.I.E (Volontariat International en Entreprise) programme. 

The V.I.E programme enables European Economic Area (EEA) nationals aged 18-28 to gain professional experience abroad through a 12-month assignment, renewable under programme conditions. Participants receive a monthly allowance and administrative support from Business France. 

Learn more: Mon Volontariat International - official VIE | VIA web site. 

Starting date: November 2026 

Type of contract: Permanent contract, or V.I.E programme, 12 months, renewable. 


Why join us? 

This permanent or V.I.E full-time Junior Project Coordinator position is well suited to a recent graduate or early-career professional looking to develop expertise in designing and enhancing learning solutions for a global audience. 

This position is based at our corporate office in Katowice, Poland, with a hybrid working model requiring office presence two days per week. Candidates based in both Katowice and Kraków are encouraged to apply. 

You will join a dynamic and international environment where several key operational functions are located. You will have the opportunity to work in a fast-growing organisation and become an internal learning expert and learning consultant, driving your own initiatives and global learning projects. 

 
What you'll gain 

Exposure to global Learning & Development projects across the Eurofins network. 

Opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from different countries and functions on a learning platform featuring 3,500 e-learning courses. 

Hands-on experience in project coordination and digital learning design. 

Development of consulting, stakeholder management and communication skills. 

A unique opportunity to grow into a Learning & Development specialist and trusted learning partner. 

Curious about the office? Get a virtual tour here.  

Qualifications

Education: Master's degree in Business, Communications, Human Resources, Science, Engineering or a related field. 

Languages: Excellent English is required. Other languages are considered a plus. 

We're looking for someone who: 

Is eager to learn and develop in Learning & Development and project coordination. 

Can manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously. 

Enjoys collaborating with diverse stakeholders in an international environment. 

Has strong communication and relationship-building skills. 

Is comfortable working independently and taking ownership of tasks. 

Experience in training, facilitation, teaching or e-learning development is considered a plus. 

IT Skills: Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Previous experience with Articulate Storyline360, or any alternative e-learning authoring tool (e.g. Articulate Rise360, Adobe Captivate, Vyond, Elucidat etc.) is a plus. 

Additional Information
We support your development! Do you feel like you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity!  As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international network of independent life sciences companies, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.
The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In under 40 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 employees across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in over 1,000 independent companies across 57 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

The Eurofins network generated EUR 7.296 billion revenues in FY 2025, and has been one of the fastest growing listed European companies for almost three decades.

246276.missionTitle: Data & CRM Business Analyst – Global Commercial Operations (H/F)
246276.missionDescription:
This V.I.E period is structured around two international assignments:
Year 1: Hungary
Year 2: Germany
We are looking for a Data & CRM Business Analyst to serve as the critical link between our Global Commercial CRM project team, the Data team, and the local commercial affiliates across our markets. Embedded within the Commercial IT / CRM Project Team, you will be the go-to person for everything data-related along the roadmap defined by the project team.

Your mandate is to ensure that data is well understood, well documented, and well used — from the way it is structured in our systems to the way it reaches the hands of local commercial teams. This means spending real time in the details: exploring datasets, making sense of country-specific data complexities, and building the shared understanding that allows technical and business teams to move forward together.

Data Understanding & Documentation
•	Deep-dive into data structures across CRM and integrated systems to understand how data flows and where issues arise
•	Maintain and update data dictionaries and functional documentation, serving as the living reference for what data exists, what it means, and how it should be used
•	Keep project documentation up to date (Confluence or equivalent)
Interface & Communication
•	Serve as the primary point of contact between the Data team, the IT/Integration team, and the local commercial affiliates
•	Work hand-in-hand with the solution architect to bridge the gap between Data, CRM, and Integration workstreams
•	Translate business needs from local teams into clear functional specifications and data definitions that the technical team can act on
•	Create wireframes and mockups based on business requirements to communicate dashboard or reporting needs to tech teams — without building them yourself
Affiliate Support & Data Quality
•	Engage directly with local market teams to understand their data specificities, constraints, and quality issues
•	Support affiliates in data cleaning and preparation efforts, providing guidance and hands-on help where needed
•	Conduct ad-hoc data exploration and analysis to answer business questions from the global commercial team
Roadmap Execution
•	Operate within the roadmap defined by the CRM project team, ensuring local needs and data requirements are properly captured and prioritized
•	Track open items, follow up on data-related actions, and flag blockers early

Sous l’autorité hiérarchique du Conseiller de coopération et d’action culturelle (COCAC), le/la VIA assurera les missions suivantes :
> Coopération universitaire et scientifique 
Le/la VIA devra connaitre l’environnement académique tanzanien ainsi que les coopérations existantes avec des établissements français. Il/elle effectuera une veille documentaire de l’enseignement supérieur dans le pays.
Enfin, il/elle sera en appui à la gestion budgétaire  et à la programmation des bourses du gouvernement français, imaginera de nouveaux programmes de mobilité en co-financement (institutions privées ou publiques) et cherchera des financements auprès de programmes existants, tel que MIC/Erasmus+.

> Coopération linguistique et/ou éducative
En lien avec les Alliances françaises, le/la VIA assurera la promotion de l’enseignement du français en Tanzanie. 
Cela se traduira notamment par l’appui à la formation des professeurs dans les établissements secondaires ou supérieurs. Il/elle appuiera notamment la TAFT (Tanzanian Association of French Teachers) en cherchant à les rendre autonomes dans leurs actions.
Jusqu’en 2027, le/la VIA est participera à la gestion d’un projet Fonds équipe France destiné à promouvoir le français au sein de l’East African Community (EAC), des organisations internationales et dans les établissements scolaires et universitaires.
Il/elle assurera également la gestion du programme Assistants de langue (de la Tanzanie vers la France) afin de sélectionner et d’accompagner les candidats choisis pour y participer.

> Espace Campus France 
Le/la VIA assurera l’animation de l’espace Campus France, basé à l’Alliance française de Dar es Salaam, lequel a pour mission de :
- promouvoir les études en France auprès des élèves et étudiants tanzaniens ;
- les accompagner jusqu’à leur départ ; 
- relayer les bourses et programmes de coopération universitaire pertinents (France Excellence Eiffel, MOPGA, etc.).
Il/elle effectuera des présentations dans les établissements, diffusera les offres des universités françaises et préparera les entretiens individuels des candidats. Il/elle assurera la programmation et le suivi budgétaire des activités de promotion.
Il/elle assurera l’animation du réseau Alumni afin de le dynamiser et de le rendre de plus en plus autonome.

Environnement professionnel, horaires de travail, disponibilité soirs/weekends : Travail au sein des locaux de l’ambassade en lien quotidien avec les équipes du SCAC et des alliances françaises. 
Horaires de travail : 8h - 17h30 pendant quatre jours et 8h - 12h30 les vendredis. En fonction de l’agenda, le/la VIA pourra être amené à participer à des évènements le soir ou le weekend, qui donnent lieu à récupération.

Règlement intérieur appliqué et droit ou non aux RTT : Le/la VIA a droit à 11 RTT par an. 

Spécificités concernant les congés : 
•	Pas de période de congés obligatoires imposée (excepté la présence à la réception du 14 juillet) ;
•	Binômat avec un autre agent du SCAC (importance d’en connaître les dossiers). 

Déplacements / missions fréquentes : Le/la VIA sera amené à se déplacer régulièrement dans différentes villes de Tanzanie, notamment Arusha (si les conditions sécuritaires de déplacement le permettent) et Zanzibar.

Composition de l’équipe de travail : Le SCAC est composé d’un conseiller de coopération et d’action culturelle (COCAC), d’une assistante/gestionnaire, d’un VIA coopération technique (société civile) et d’un VIA coopération culturelle.

M&A Transactions

o	Procurement and sourcing synergies
o	Margin, and profitability improvement
o	R&D and product portfolio alignment
•	Analyze operational and financial data to identify performance levers
•	Track integration progress and report key issues to senior management

Cross-Functional & Strategic Projects

•	Strategic analysis 
•	Operational performance improvement projects

•	Manufacturing footprint and capacity analysis

246288.missionDescription:
Context
PWR-T Business Group organization and facilities, within Nexans Norway AS and its subsidiaries.

Purpose
The V.I.E. supports the Environmental & Sustainability Manager in coordinating environmental and sustainability activities across Power Transmission BG, while also providing administrative and reporting support for key compliance and follow-up processes.

The role combines:

administrative support for environment and sustainability activities,
follow-up of environmental and sustainability topics in Synergi Life,
support for regulatory reporting, permits and compliance tracking,
and contribution to the continuous improvement of environmental management practices across PWR-T.

Areas of Responsibility

Administrative Support for Environment & Sustainability
Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Environmental & Sustainability Manager for environment and sustainability topics. Support the preparation, consolidation and follow-up of presentations, reports, action plans, meeting materials and internal communications. Coordinate meetings, workshops and follow-up actions with sites, functions and project teams. Maintain trackers, deadlines and documentation linked to environmental compliance, sustainability initiatives and related action plans. Support the collection, consolidation and quality check of environmental and sustainability data from sites and internal stakeholders.

Synergi Life Follow-up – Environment & Sustainability
Act as a support user for environmental and sustainability follow-up in Synergi Life within PWR-T. Ensure that environmental incidents, observations, non-conformities and action plans are properly registered, updated and followed up in line with internal HSSE processes. Monitor action status, deadlines and closure quality in Synergi Life, and escalate overdue or incomplete actions where needed. Support the preparation of dashboards, summaries and trend analyses related to environmental and sustainability events and actions. Contribute to sharing lessons learned and improving the quality and consistency of reporting in Synergi Life.

Environmental Compliance & Reporting Support
Support the coordination of environmental compliance activities across PWR-T. Assist in the collection, validation and consolidation of data required for regulatory reporting, including REACH and microplastics reporting to ECHA. Help maintain environmental records, reporting files and supporting documentation to ensure traceability and timely submission. Support follow-up of environmental permits and compliance obligations, including updates in Red-on-Line and monitoring of key deadlines. Assist in preparing documentation and information requested by authorities, auditors or internal stakeholders.

Environmental Management System & Continuous Improvement
Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the Environmental Management System (EMS) in alignment with ISO 14001 and corporate requirements. Contribute to the follow-up of audits, action plans, compliance reviews and improvement initiatives. Help update procedures, work instructions, templates and internal tools related to environmental and sustainability management. Support the tracking of KPIs related to environment, sustainability, permits, reporting and action follow-up.

Coordination, Awareness & Cross-Functional Support
Work closely with HSSE, Quality, Operations, R&D, Procurement, Project Management and other stakeholders on environmental and sustainability topics. Support the preparation and coordination of awareness sessions, training materials and communication initiatives. Contribute to fostering a proactive culture of environmental compliance, sustainability awareness and structured follow-up.

KPIs
Timeliness and quality of environmental and sustainability reporting; quality and closure rate of actions followed up in Synergi Life; follow-up of permit obligations and compliance deadlines; quality of environmental data consolidation and documentation; support to audits, reviews and continuous improvement actions.

Key Interfaces
Internal: PWR-T HSSE, Environmental & Sustainability Manager, Quality Management, Operations, Maintenance, R&D, Procurement, Project Management, Nexans corporate HSSE / Sustainability / Legal, data owners for REACH and microplastic reporting.
External: Regulatory authorities (as delegated), external consultants, laboratories, auditors and service providers related to chemicals, permits, environmental risk and environmental management.

Expected Results
Reliable and structured administrative support provided to the Environmental & Sustainability Manager; effective and timely follow-up of environment and sustainability actions in Synergi Life; accurate consolidation of environmental and sustainability data for internal and external reporting; good follow-up of environmental permits, reporting obligations and compliance deadlines; improved visibility on environmental and sustainability performance through clear reporting and dashboards; strong support to continuous improvement of environmental and sustainability processes across PWR-T.

246320.missionTitle: Ingénieur Test & Mise en Service ICC (H/F)
246320.missionDescription:
Nous rejoindre, c’est rejoindre une entreprise bienveillante, responsable et innovante où plus de 80 000 personnes ouvrent la voie à une mobilité plus verte et plus intelligente dans le monde entier. 

Pourriez-vous être le/la VIE ICC Test and Commissioning Engineer, basé(e) à Montréal, Canada, que nous recherchons ? 

 

Votre futur rôle

Relevez un nouveau défi et développez votre expertise dans les essais et la mise en service de systèmes ferroviaires intégrés. 

Au sein de la solution SLV (« Signalling & Low Voltage ») d’Alstom, l’ATS (« Automatic Train Supervision ») a pour fonction de superviser et réguler la circulation des trains, tandis que le SCADA (« Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition ») permet la gestion de l’énergie de traction, des équipements électromécaniques et de la ventilation en tunnel. En outre, le CSP (« Cybersecurity Platform ») fournit des services de cybersécurité à l'ensemble du système SLV et à d'autres acteurs externes.La combinaison de ces 3 sous-systèmes forme l’entité dénommée « Integrated Control Center » (ICC).. 

L’objectif du poste est de contribuer à la préparation et à l’exécution des essais sur site des sous-systèmes ICC, conformément aux exigences contractuelles, à la stratégie du projet et aux politiques de l’entreprise en matière d’EHS, de sécurité ferroviaire et de qualité. 

Vous serez rattaché(e) au ICC T&C Manager. Vous collaborerez avec les équipes T&C, installation, ingénierie, support technique, ainsi qu’avec les partenaires et sous-traitants du projet.

 

Nous ferons appel à vous pour 

Participer à la préparation des activités d’essais et de mise en service des sous-systèmes ICC.
Contribuer à la rédaction et à la mise à jour des procédures et cahiers d’essais. 
Vérifier la disponibilité et la conformité des prérequis avant le démarrage des essais. 
Exécuter les essais statiques, fonctionnels, d’intégration et de performance. 
Enregistrer les résultats et rédiger les rapports d’essais. 
Identifier, documenter et déclarer les anomalies détectées. 
Participer à l’analyse, au dépannage et au suivi des anomalies avec les équipes concernées. 
Réaliser les essais de vérification et de non-régression après correction. 
Participer aux activités de configuration et de déploiement des équipements et logiciels ICC. 
Maintenir à jour les outils de suivi des essais, des anomalies et des actions. 
Soutenir la préparation des démonstrations et des activités d’acceptation avec le client. 
Fournir régulièrement un état d’avancement au responsable T&C concerné. 
Respecter les règles EHS, les procédures de sécurité ferroviaire et les processus qualité applicables au projet.

You will gain exposure to medical strategy at different stages of the launch: (1) pre-launch including medical education and market shaping, (2) evolution of medical narratives based on evidence generation, and (3) strategic data dissemination based on clinical management needs.

Join the engine of Sanofi’s mission — where deep immunoscience meets bold, AI-powered research. In R&D, you’ll drive breakthroughs that could turn the impossible into possible for millions.

Ready to get started?

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

- Support Global Medical Lead (GML) with implementation of the Global Medical Plan, with a key focus on project management and driving implementation of medical narrative across omnichannel initiatives.

- Work at the forefront of AI-powered science that accelerates discovery and improves outcomes.
- Collaborate beyond your expertise, sparking new ideas with diverse, multidisciplinary teams.
- Work at the forefront of drug discovery, harnessing cutting-edge AI, data, and digital platforms to push the boundaries of science.

- Join a workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core, with Employee Resource Groups and leadership programs that celebrate every voice.

iMove is a unique program tailored for European youth interested in challenging themselves with meaningful assignments across the globe. At Sanofi we have a strong ambition to invest in young talents who will drive the success of Sanofi tomorrow.

Sanofi’s Work Abroad Program, iMove, offers jobs-assignments with actual responsibilities and a perspective to grow. Sanofi unites people who are passionate about solving healthcare needs across the world. Joining our iMove Work Abroad Program is a unique opportunity to make a difference through your work.

Pursue Progress. Discover Extraordinary.

Progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. En pleine croissance, le groupe structure ses fonctions support et crée ce poste clé au sein de l’équipe RH & Finance groupe, basée à Genève. 

Vous en êtes le garant des cycles financiers pour l’ensemble du groupe. Facturation, encaissements, clôtures, reporting, forecast : vous tenez les chiffres qui permettent à la direction de décider et vous êtes son interlocuteur direct au quotidien.

Mission 1 : Facturation & encaissement (30 %)

Mission 3 : Comptabilité, clôtures & trésorerie (20 %)

Communiquer de manière claire, fiable et proactive avec la direction 
Axe transverse : Transformation, automatisation & IA (10 %) 
Cartographier les processus financiers, identifier les tâches manuelles et les risques d’erreur 
Déployer des automatisations : contrôles d’anomalies, préparation des relances, rapprochements, reporting 
Identifier et mettre en œuvre des cas d’usage pertinents de l’IA pour la fonction finance 
Documenter procédures, responsabilités et règles de validation 

Vos 6 premiers mois 
Des objectifs clairs, sur lesquels nous nous engageons ensemble : 
Un calendrier groupe de facturation et de clôture sécurisé et respecté 
Un volume de prestations non facturées et de factures rejetées en nette baisse 
Un P&L mensuel exploitable par Business Manager 
Un forecast de trésorerie et de performance structuré 
Au moins deux automatisations mesurables déployées

Référence dans l'industrie aérospatiale, Gardner Aerospace est l'un des principaux fabricants de composants métalliques finis. Basé au Royaume-Uni, dans l'Union européenne et en Asie, le groupe fournit des pièces usinées, des fabrications en tôle et des sous-ensembles à l'industrie aérospatiale et de défense. Implanté dans 5 pays et disposant de 9 usines, le groupe compte plus de 2 000 employés.

La stratégie et la vision de Gardner consistent à être un leader dans la consolidation du segment en :

- Offrant l'excellence opérationnelle et les meilleurs produits et processus de leur catégorie.

- Fournissant en permanence de la valeur ajoutée aux clients grâce à une chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale entièrement intégrée de bout en bout.

- Étant une entreprise fiable et transparente qui prend au sérieux ses propres responsabilités et celles de ses clients.

- Continuant à bâtir une organisation et une culture efficaces et performantes, basées sur le travail d'équipe.

D’ambitieux défis nous attendent, saurez-vous les relever avec nous ? Rejoignez nos équipes !

Cette année, le programme évolue afin d'explorer comment l'IA peut être appliquée à l'ensemble de nos opérations pour créer une réelle valeur commerciale.

Vous contribuerez activement à la définition, au test et au déploiement de cas d'utilisation basés sur l'IA, contribuant ainsi à façonner l'avenir de notre paysage numérique.

En parallèle, vous participerez à des projets mondiaux majeurs, notamment le déploiement d'un nouveau système ERP mondial,une étape clé dans la feuille de route numérique de Gardner. Il s'agit d'une occasion unique d'acquérir une expérience pratique du secteur tout en travaillant à la pointe de l'innovation numérique au sein d'une organisation aérospatiale mondiale.

En tant que membre de l'équipe de transformation numérique, vous suivrez des méthodologies structurées de gestion de projet afin de fournir des solutions numériques efficaces. Vous apporterez votre soutien à certains de nos projets (liste indicative) :

- Déploiement d'un système mondial de planification des ressources d'entreprise (ERP)
- Système d'exécution de la fabrication (MES)
- Production sans papier / Ordres de travail numériques
- Suivi en intérieur
- Solutions logistiques avancées
- Gestion des données de référence
- Catalogue mondial Power-Bi
- Plateforme EDI interentreprises
- Développements Microsoft Power Platform
- Exploration et développement de cas d'utilisation de l'IA intégrés aux opérations

Tout au long de votre apprentissage, vous acquerrez des compétences clés et mettrez en pratique des méthodes éprouvées dans le secteur, qui contribueront directement à l'obtention de votre diplôme tout en apportant une valeur ajoutée à notre entreprise.

Vous travaillerez avec différentes équipes au sein d'une organisation mondiale afin de fournir des solutions numériques performantes et de mettre en place des processus et des pratiques standardisés sur les différents sites et dans les différents domaines d'activité.

About the job

As Global Oncology Market Access Junior Project Specialist VIE within our Global Market Access & Pricing team, you’ll support the Global Oncology Market Access and Pricing Leads on a broad range of strategic projects and operational activities for various oncologic assets, and other team members for specific projects.

The scope will include pre-launch planning/preparation & project management for either a) Sanofi's early oncology pipeline and oncology access policy workstreams, or b) Sarclisa lifecycle management; in addition to operational responsibilities and other department assignments.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

Ready to get started?

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. 

Main responsibilities:

- Inform and shape strategies of prelaunch or inline products in scope with respect to market access and pricing relevant aspects.
- Support the Global Market Access and Pricing Team Lead in development of relevant strategic deliverables for pipeline and prelaunch products, such as:
Treatment and payer landscape assessment.
Value proposition and value communication tools, negotiation guide, country training programs, etc.
Market access strategy development.
Pricing analysis.
- Support local access, pricing and reimbursement activities as per global strategy including organizing and steering governance for internal approval of country price and access strategies in close collaboration with Sanofi Catalyst Team.
- Liaise with countries and other matrix partners - Health Economics and Value Assessment (HEVA, Clinical Development, NPP, Regulatory, Market Access and Pricing, Commercial, Regulatory for requests, queries, analyses and consolidated input.
- Foster information sharing including best practices.
- Coordination and management of monthly country calls, Global Managed Access Program (GMAP)/HEVA reccurring meetings, country communications, planning and facilitation of summits, training and workshops.

Why choose us?

- Be part of a pioneering biopharma company where patient insights shape drug development.
- Work at the forefront of AI-powered science that accelerates discovery and improves outcomes.
- Collaborate beyond your expertise, sparking new ideas with diverse, multidisciplinary teams.
- Drive meaningful impact at global scale: our medicines reach more than 100 million people each year.
- Thrive in inclusive, flexible workplaces that support your personal and professional well-being.
- Launch your career with a company that invests in you — and empowers you to reimagine what’s possible.
- Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve.

iMove is a unique program tailored for European youth interested in challenging themselves with meaningful assignments across the globe. At Sanofi we have a strong ambition to invest in young talents who will drive the success of Sanofi tomorrow. 

Sanofi’s Work Abroad Program, iMove, offers jobs-assignments with actual responsibilities and a perspective to grow. We provide those opportunities in various functions such as: marketing, finance, regulatory, supply chain, clinical trials, production, etc. and in more than 40 countries. Sanofi unites people who are passionate about solving healthcare needs across the world. Joining our iMove Work Abroad Program is a unique opportunity to make a difference through your work. 

Pursue Progress. Discover Extraordinary. 

Progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. You can be one of those people. Chasing change, embracing new ideas and exploring all the opportunities we have to offer. Let’s pursue progress. And let’s discover extraordinary together.

245476.missionDescription:
I-care Reliability Inc. (part of I-care Group) is the global leader in predictive and prescriptive maintenance. Using AI, data analytics and industrial expertise, we predict machine failures months or even years in advance, helping industrial companies improve performance and avoid downtime. With over1000 employees, 35 offices in 16 countries, we monitor more than 500,000 machines.

In order to support our operations in the US, we are looking to expand our operations team at mulitple customer locations across the US, e.g. Valdosta, GA. 

I-care is seeking a highly analytical and proactive Reliability Engineer to join our team. The primary focus of this role is to identify and manage asset reliability risks that could adversely affect plant or business operations. You will champion continuous improvement by applying engineering principles to predict, manage, and extend the lifecycle of our equipment. Working closely with maintenance, operations, and technical teams, you will develop data-driven strategies to minimize downtime, reduce maintenance costs, and ensure a safe, environmentally compliant workplace.

Key Responsibilities :
- Support a culture of safety by adhering to OSHA regulations and plant environmental standards.
- Support the maintenance team by updating and optimizing Preventive Maintenance (PM) plans within the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
- Help compile failure data and production metrics to identify trends, assisting in methodologies like Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA).
- Maintain accurate documentation for equipment lifecycles, critical spare parts, and reliability metrics.
- Utilize statistical tools and failure data, to identify trends and eliminate production "bad actors."
- Assist senior engineers and technicians in conducting Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) to understand equipment breakdowns and prevent recurrence.
- Partner with capital project teams during the design, installation, and commissioning phases to ensure the reliability and maintainability of new and modified assets.
- Collect and help analyze data from condition-based monitoring tools (such as vibration analysis, oil analysis, and thermography).
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including operations and maintenance, to learn plant processes and support troubleshooting efforts.
- Participate in training and shadowing opportunities to build foundational knowledge in precision maintenance and reliability engineering.
245476.missionProfile:
Minimum Qualifications :
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or Industrial Engineering.
- 0 to 3 years of professional experience in reliability engineering, industrial manufacturing, or plant maintenance.
- Proven experience executing reliability methodologies, including FMEA, RCFA, and Fault Tree Analysis.
- High proficiency in utilizing Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), such as SAP, Maximo, or similar platforms.
- Theoritacal knowledge of condition-monitoring technologies and non-destructive testing (NDT).
- Familiarity with relevant U.S. engineering and industry codes (e.g., ASME, API, ANSI).

Essential Skills :
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a commitment to data-driven decision-making.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate complex technical issues to non-engineers and cross-functional teams.
- Ability to effectively influence operations and maintenance teams to drive change without direct authority.
- Solid project management skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.

Join our teams mobilized to meet the challenge of accelerating electrification!

At the heart of electric mobility, Valeo Power brings together expertise in thermal management systems and propulsion systems. This division develops innovations that contribute to the mobility of tomorrow by reducing pollutant emissions and maximizing vehicle autonomy.

- You will support APU and Site Managers in analyzing assigned QRQC issues and ensure meeting rules like "Stop at first disagree/no" are strictly followed.
- You will perform line and LLC Stability audits to enforce compliance with Standards, identifying necessary corrective actions with the APU.

Vous avez de l’énergie à revendre et êtes proactif ? Vous disposez d’un esprit de conquête ? Vous êtes ambitieux et avez la capacité de rebondir en toute circonstance ? Vous souhaitez exploiter votre aisance relationnelle, et exprimer votre leadership ?

•	Vous préférez décrocher votre téléphone plutôt que d’envoyer un mail

NGen Bruxelles en quelques mots :

246284.missionDescription:
IRL Crossing est un laboratoire international du CNRS en collaboration avec des universités australiennes, IMT atlantique et Naval Group. Il est situé à Adélaïde, à l'intérieur de l'université.
Il étudie les interactions entre systèmes autonomes, facteurs humains et intelligence artificielle.
Naval Group est un leader mondial de la défense navale. Le groupe conçoit, produit et assure le support des sous-marins et des navires de surface. Il fournit également des services pour les chantiers navals et les bases navales. 
 
À propos du projet
LOTUSim est la plateforme de simulation maritime multi-agents open source de Naval Group. Reposant sur Gazebo, ROS2 et l’intégration physique xdyn, elle permet la modélisation de véhicules autonomes de surface et sous-marins (USV, UUV, ROV), de capteurs sonar et de scénarios multi-agents pour des applications de R&D navale.
LOTUSim est activement utilisé par des doctorants et des partenaires en France et en Australie.
 
Vos missions
Au sein de l’équipe de développement de LOTUSim, vous serez amené(e) à :
-          Servir d’interface locale entre l’équipe de Naval Group France et l’IRL, en veillant à ce que les attentes du chef de projet soient bien prises en compte sur place.
-          Contribuer au développement et à l’intégration de modules de simulation (modélisation de plateformes, plugins de capteurs, scénarios multi-agents) au sein de la pile ROS2/Gazebo/xdyn
-          Implémenter et tester de nouvelles fonctionnalités en Python et C++, en suivant les meilleures pratiques en matière d’ingénierie logicielle open source
-          Rédiger la documentation technique et les tests unitaires pour les fonctionnalités que vous livrez
-          Participer aux revues techniques, à la planification des sprints et aux réunions d’équipe
-          Collaborer avec des doctorants et des contributeurs externes utilisant LOTUSim à des fins de recherche
-          Assurer la liaison avec les autres entités et filiales de Naval Group impliquées dans le projet
 
 
Les entretiens de recrutement vous permettront d’échanger avec le manager du pôle et ainsi d’en apprendre davantage sur l’ensemble de vos missions.

As Scientific Advisor Sarilumab VIE within our Medical team, you will play a pivotal role in supporting the strategic and scientific direction of the Alliance Immunology Rheumatology Franchise. You will partner with the Global Medical Director Kevzara acting as a key support in driving medical affairs initiatives forward, and will work cross-functionally, helping to shape efficient and optimized global strategies while also applying your scientific expertise to critical projects.

Ready to get started?

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

- Be part of a pioneering biopharma company where patient insights shape drug development.

Pursue Progress. Discover Extraordinary. 

Progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. You can be one of those people. Chasing change, embracing new ideas and exploring all the opportunities we have to offer. Let’s pursue progress. And let’s discover extraordinary together.

Planisware is looking for a curious, analytical, and technology-oriented Business Systems Engineer (VIE) to support internal systems, process improvement, and digital transformation projects. Security, Compliance & Governance

AI Transformation & Innovation

Cross-Functional Strategic Initiatives

This is a hybrid role, requiring in office work 4x a week, Monday-Thursday, and remote work allowed on Friday.

•	Interpret analytical data to determine the likely origin and nature of unknown particles.
•	Prepare technical reports and communicate findings to project, quality, and cross-functional teams.

LC-MS and GC-MS Method Development and Application
•	Develop, optimize, and execute analytical methods using liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) and gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS).
•	Support structural elucidation and identification of extractables and leachables (E&L), degradation products, and unknown compounds.
•	Perform routine analyses as well as complex investigations requiring interpretation of mass spectral data.
•	Contribute to instrument maintenance, troubleshooting, and qualification activities.
Analytical Method Validation
•	Participate in the planning and execution of analytical method validation studies.
•	Assess method performance characteristics including specificity, accuracy, precision, linearity, robustness, solution stability, and range.
•	Previous experience with analytical method validation is considered an advantage but is not mandatory.
Stability Testing
•	Prepare and analyze samples generated from stability study programs.
•	Review and interpret analytical results.
•	Support investigations related to atypical, out-of-trend, or unexpected stability results.

Présentation de la société :

Spécialiste de la conception et de la réalisation complète d’outillages dans les secteurs de l'automobile, de l'aéronautique, du ferroviaire ainsi que dans d'autres secteurs industriels, ALLIO GROUP propose à ses clients, comprenant de grands acteurs et des donneurs d'ordre clés, des solutions de fabrication sur mesure et des services d’ingénierie de haute qualité.

L'entreprise offre des prestations complexes ainsi que la fabrication de pièces mécaniques de précision. Ces services répondent aux besoins spécifiques de ses clients, qu'il s'agisse de prototypes ou de séries, tout en garantissant des résultats fiables et adaptés.

PME européenne dynamique de plus de 50 collaborateurs, affichant un chiffre d’affaires de plus de 6 M€, ALLIO GROUP est issu d’un groupe industriel français de renom. Forte d’une longue expérience et d’une expertise éprouvée, l’entreprise conjugue l’agilité de ses processus de fabrication à une maîtrise technique reconnue.

Présent en Roumanie et en France depuis 2006, et au Portugal depuis 2022, le groupe ALLIO est aujourd’hui reconnu en Europe et à l’international pour la qualité de ses prestations, sa réactivité et sa compétitivité.


Poste et missions :

Objectif général de la mission :

En tant que Field Engineer basé au Portugal, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le suivi opérationnel des affaires techniques d’Allio France, en lien étroit avec les équipes projets, la direction industrielle, les fournisseurs portugais et les clients finaux. Votre mission combinera une forte dimension technique, une relation quotidienne avec les partenaires industriels, ainsi qu’une implication dans le développement du panel fournisseurs, de nouveaux outils de suivi, et éventuellement des produits et process Allio.

Responsabilités principales :

1. Suivi de projets outillages au Portugal
Suivi d’éléments d’outillages et d’outillages complets en fabrication chez les fournisseurs et partenaires portugais
Participation aux revues projet, au suivi et à l’accompagnement des fournisseurs, aux validations techniques et aux visites clients

2.  Présence terrain et accompagnement client
Déplacements réguliers sur les sites clients pour comprendre et analyser les nouveaux besoins et contraintes techniques
Échanges directs avec les clients afin d’identifier et de proposer sur place des solutions techniques adaptées, et participation à l’élaboration des offres correspondantes
Participation aux phases d’installation, de mise au point et de validation des projets chez les clients
Suivi des équipements et outillages après livraison et contribution au service après-vente
Grande disponibilité et réactivité en cas de problème ou de besoin d’intervention sur site
Développement d’une relation de proximité et de confiance avec les clients, en assurant le lien entre leurs équipes et les équipes techniques d’Allio

3. Support aux activités Direct Manufacturing d’Allio France
Suivi des appels d’offres et des affaires (analyse technique, chiffrage, contact fournisseurs & clients)
Accompagnement du projet de A à Z : choix fournisseurs, suivi de production, support technique, respect qualité/délais
Participation à la gestion des non-conformités, service après-vente et bilans d’affaires

4. Gestion et développement du panel fournisseurs
Suivi régulier, audits, qualification et intégration de nouveaux fournisseurs
Maintien d’un lien étroit et professionnel avec les partenaires industriels locaux

5. Contribution au développement du groupe Allio
Création d’outils de suivi, de communication et de validation
Amélioration continue (digitalisation, process, organisation du bureau Allio Portugal)
Participation au lancement de nouveaux process de fabrication
Soutien aux démarches commerciales (clients inactifs, prospects, nouveaux produits/procédés)

Contexte et environnement :

Le poste est basé à Marinha Grande, une région particulièrement agréable à vivre : le coût de la vie y est très abordable, la qualité de vie et la gastronomie excellentes, et vous serez à proximité de Leiria (ville dynamique de taille moyenne) ainsi que de l’océan Atlantique, avec de nombreuses plages réputées à quelques minutes, dont Nazaré, célèbre spot de surf.

Située à mi-chemin entre Lisbonne et Porto, cette localisation centrale permet des déplacements faciles dans tout le pays. Le Portugal, pays à taille humaine, offre un cadre idéal pour conjuguer efficacité professionnelle (visites régulières chez les fournisseurs) et découverte culturelle et personnelle.

Vous serez accompagné(e) de manière bienveillante par les trois associés du groupe Allio, jeunes quadragénaires dynamiques, très expérimentés dans l’expatriation et dans le développement de projets à l’international. La gestion de l’entreprise se fait dans un véritable esprit de famille, avec une grande ouverture aux nouvelles idées, à l’innovation et aux initiatives personnelles.

Vous serez également accompagné(e) au quotidien par Rita, responsable logistique et administrative d’Allio Portugal, reconnue pour sa bienveillance et sa disponibilité, ainsi que par les managers des deux sociétés partenaires portugaises, voisines d’Allio et partenaires historiques du groupe, eux aussi très bienveillants et engagés dans un esprit de collaboration.

237223.missionDescription:
Role Summary

The Product Owner is responsible for maximizing the value delivered by the development team by maintaining a clear strategic vision and ensuring perfect alignment between business goals, customer needs, and product execution. Acting as the primary bridge between stakeholders and technical teams, the Product Owner defines the product vision, translates strategy into actionable requirements, manages the product backlog, and ensures deliverables meet business expectations and quality standards.
 This role requires strong communication, prioritization, and analytical skills, as well as the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive continuous improvement across the product lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Vision & Strategy
•	Define and articulate a compelling product vision aligned with business objectives, market dynamics, and user needs.
•	Create and maintain an evolving product roadmap that communicates priorities, timelines, and strategic milestones.
•	Analyze trends, competitive insights, and customer feedback to inform long‑term product strategy.
•	Ensure stakeholders understand the vision, value proposition, and expected outcomes of planned product features.

2. Backlog Management & Prioritization
•	Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring it is visible, transparent, and clearly communicated.
•	Break down strategic initiatives into well‑defined epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
•	Prioritize backlog items using data‑driven decision‑making, balancing user value, technical feasibility, dependencies, and team capacity.
•	Continuously refine and groom the backlog to ensure readiness for upcoming sprints.

3. Requirements Gathering & User Story Definition
•	Collaborate with business stakeholders, end users, and cross‑functional teams to gather and validate requirements.
•	Translate needs into user stories with clear acceptance criteria, ensuring alignment with UX/UI and technical standards.
•	Validate that implemented features meet user expectations and deliver measurable value.

4. Collaboration with Development Teams
•	Partner with development, QA, architecture, UX, and PMO teams to ensure shared understanding of scope, goals, and requirements.
•	Actively participate in Agile ceremonies such as Sprint Planning, Reviews, Retrospectives, and Daily Stand‑ups.
•	Provide ongoing clarification to the team and support iterative development through feedback loops.
•	Remove blockers and make timely decisions to maintain delivery flow.

5. Delivery & Quality Assurance
•	Review and accept completed stories based on established acceptance criteria and quality benchmarks.
•	Ensure that delivered features perform as expected and align with business and user needs.
•	Track key performance indicators (KPIs), product metrics, and usage data to inform future enhancements.

6. Stakeholder Relations
•	Act as the voice of the product, maintaining fluid communication with business teams, leadership, and external partners.
•	Present product updates, progress reports, and roadmap changes in a clear and structured manner.
•	Manage expectations and facilitate alignment between diverse stakeholder groups.
7. Continuous Improvement
•	Promote a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and improvement.
•	Identify inefficiencies or bottlenecks in the product development workflow and propose actionable enhancements.
•	Monitor feedback channels and encourage customer-centric decision-making.

La Business Line IBC intervient pour FRAMATOME sur tous les projets de construction du nouveau nucléaire (EPR première génération, EPR2, EPR1200, SMR...). En fonction des projets, sur les scopes primaires et auxiliaire, IBC est en charge des préfabrications et du montage des tuyauteries et du montage des équipements. IBC est par conséquent impliqué dans diverses activités telles que : la production des études de montage, la production des dossiers de réalisation, le développement d'outillages et de procédés, les opérations physiques de préfabrication et montage en atelier et sur Site.

 

La mission se déroulera sur le chantier de construction de 2 centrales nucléaires d’Hinkley Point C, au Royaume-Uni, parmi les chantiers les plus importants au monde, au sein des équipes en charge des activités de préparation et suivi technique des montages du scope chaudière nucléaire de Framatome.



Cet appel à candidature est destiné à un poste d’ingénieur Soudeur.
La mission consistera à accompagner les équipes techniques et opérationnelles sur des thématiques liées au soudage et aux contrôles non destructifs

Participera à la préparation des dossiers pour les activités de soudage et contrôle du circuit primaire.
Traitera les adaptations et les non-conformités issues du chantier et proposera des solutions.
Accompagnera les ingénieurs des autres disciplines dans la résolution de thématiques multidisciplinaires.
Clarifiera et adaptera les spécifications techniques si nécessaire.
Animera les réunions techniques avec les fournisseurs ou toutes autres entités support nécessaires.
Collectera le REX soudage

Use case discovery and qualification

Delivery and adoption

Continuous improvement and reporting

Observations particulières sur le poste :

Horaires de l’Ambassade de France :
de 07 H 30 à 13 H 30 du dimanche au jeudi,
et de 15 H 00 à 17 H 50 les lundis, mardis et mercredis.

Les fonctions requièrent une disponibilité particulière en dehors des horaires officiels (visites officielles, couverture d’événements organisés par l’Ambassade, déplacements en région)

246114.missionDescription:
Ontario Line South
Ferrovial Construction Canada Inc. and VINCI Construction Grands Projects are to design, build
and finance the Ontario Line Southern Civil, Stations and Tunnel (South Civil) package. 
Working together as Ontario Transit Group we are currently mobilizing our design and construction crews, with major works to commence in 2024. The South Civil contract is anticipated to be completed in 2030.
The project will strengthen Ontario’s economy by supporting an estimated 1,500 jobs at the peak of construction.

What is the project?
•	A six-kilometer tunnel and associated tunnelling works from Exhibition to Don Yard portal (west of the Don River)
•	Stations:
•	One above-ground station to be integrated with the existing GO Transit Exhibition Station
•	Two underground stations to be integrated with the existing TTC Osgoode and Queen subway stations
•	Four new underground stations (King/Bathurst, Queen/Spadina, Moss Park, Corktown)

The benefits to Ontario!
Faster, more frequent and reliable access to rapid transit with more than 227,500 people will live within a 10-minute walk of an Ontario Line station
•	Improve the quality of life for commuters by reducing daily travel time
•	Reduce crowding on the existing Line 1 (Yonge-University) subway
•	Up to 57,000 more jobs accessible by transit (in 45 minutes or less) for Toronto residents
•	Economic and community growth along the future transit line and thousands of job opportunities annually during construction
•	Reduction in traffic congestion, greenhouse gases and fuel consumption by providing an alternative transportation option

 
Job Description:
•	Work as part of the team to deliver and execute the works schedule across the OLS project

243340.missionDescription:
Dans le cadre du développement de nos opérations, Hello Watt renforce l'équipe chargée du pilotage de l’activité comparateur avec un nouveau poste de Real-Time Analyst en VIE, basé sur notre site de Valence.
Ton rôle : être le garant de la performance opérationnelle au quotidien en répartissant le flux de la meilleure manière entre les différents sites, en tenant compte des contraintes de planification, avec un objectif clair : garantir à nos clients une réponse rapide et une satisfaction élevée. C'est toi qui fais le lien entre la planification et le terrain, en pilotant les flux en direct, en anticipant les déséquilibres et en actionnant les bons leviers pour que les équipes performent dans les meilleures conditions.
Tu travailles en interaction directe avec l’équipe chargée du pilotage du comparateur, les responsables d'équipe, les directeurs de nos sites opérationnels et les responsables d’équipe, dans un environnement où chaque décision compte et où ton impact est visible directement.

Tes missions :

Piloter la performance en temps réel
Tu es aux commandes de la production : tu surveilles en continu les indicateurs clés, détectés les écarts entre le flux entrant et le staffing disponible sur chaque site de production, et prends des décisions immédiates pour maintenir la qualité de service. Tu es le premier à identifier quand ça coince, et le premier à agir.
- Surveiller en continu les KPIs clés sur l'ensemble des campagnes entrantes et sortantes.
- Identifier les déséquilibres entre le flux et le staffing disponible et ajuster la répartition en temps réel entre les différentes campagnes et sites.
- Prendre des mesures correctives immédiates pour maintenir la qualité de service : réaffectation des tickets, ajustement des permissions, gestion des tickets à forte valeur (urgences, RDV, rappels).
- Anticiper les pics et les creux de flux avant qu'ils n'impactent la performance, et alerter les équipes concernées (Marketing, Ops, sites) pour déclencher les actions adaptées.

Coordonner les équipes et gérer les incidents
Tu es le point de contact central entre les opérations, les sites, l'équipe comparateur et les outils. Tu coordonnes les actions en temps réel et t'assure que chaque équipe dispose des ressources et des informations nécessaires pour atteindre ses objectifs.
- Gestion des plannings et conformité des accès en lien avec les directeurs de site et responsables d'équipe.
- Maîtrise et administration de nos outils internes (CRM, Outil de téléphonie, outils internes).
- Remontée des dysfonctionnements outils à l'équipe produit, avec des propositions d'amélioration concrètes.
- Coordination des actions correctives avec les différentes équipes .

Analyser, recommander, améliorer
Au-delà du temps réel, tu analyses chaque jour les performances de la veille à partir de notre reporting daily, identifies les écarts et formules des recommandations concrètes aux équipes pour améliorer la performance sur le long terme.
- Analyse quotidienne des KPIs de performance et identification des tendances via nos outils de reporting.
- Formulation de recommandations aux responsables d'équipe et directeurs de site en fonction de l'atteinte des objectifs.
- Contrôle régulier de la qualité de traitement sur nos outils de production (CRM, Outil de téléphonie, outils internes) : respect des process, conformité des communications et des tentatives d'appels.
- Réalisation d'analyses ponctuelles selon les besoins de l'activité.

Les valeurs d’Hello Watt:
- Impact more : nous accompagnons les particuliers dans la transition énergétique et nous utilisons la tech pour leur permettre de maîtriser leur consommation. Nous visons grand pour maximiser cet impact.
- User focused : à l’écoute de nos clients, nous cherchons à les étonner par la qualité de notre service et de nos produits.
- One caring team : nous veillons au bien être et au développement de chacun en fondant nos relations sur l’humilité et l’honnêteté.

Déroulement des entretiens:
- Premier entretien en visio ou par téléphone
- Etude de cas et debrief avec Chloé, notre analyste stratégie & opérations
- Dernier entretien avec le directeur du site

Depuis plus de 100 ans, Cahouet est l'un des principaux spécialistes de la conception et de la fabrication d'équipements destinés à la mise en œuvre de gaz industriels, médicaux et alimentaires, sous haute et basse pression.

la santé et le médical ;
l'agroalimentaire ;
l'aéronautique ;
la défense et le militaire ;
l'industrie.

Business Developer Export – Zone Asie

Développement commercial

•          Adaptation des supports et de la documentation commerciale

Chez Cahouet, nous considérons le V.I.E. comme une expérience professionnelle formative et internationale.
Avant votre départ et tout au long de votre mission vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement régulier du Responsable Commercial et des équipes expertes basées en France afin de développer progressivement votre connaissance :
•          De l'entreprise et de son organisation ; des produits et technologies Cahouet 
•          Des applications liées aux gaz industriels, médicaux et alimentaires 
•          Des marchés et secteurs d'activité adressés 
•          Des méthodes et outils de développement commercial ; des spécificités des marchés asiatiques
Votre niveau de responsabilité et votre périmètre d'intervention évolueront progressivement en fonction de votre montée en compétences et de votre connaissance de l'environnement Cahouet.

Ce que cette expérience vous apportera :
Ce V.I.E. vous permettra de construire une expérience particulièrement complète, à la croisée de la technique, du commerce et de l'international.

Vous développerez notamment :
Une expertise technique.
Compréhension de produits et solutions destinés à des environnements industriels exigeants.
Des compétences commerciales.
Prospection, analyse de marché, relation client, offres technico-commerciales et développement d'affaires.

Immersion professionnelle en Asie et collaboration avec des interlocuteurs de cultures différentes.
Un réseau professionnel international.
Clients, distributeurs, partenaires et équipes internes.
Une vision globale du développement export.
De l'identification d'une opportunité jusqu'au suivi de la relation client.

Et après le V.I.E. ?
Cette mission s'inscrit dans la stratégie de développement international de Cahouet.
À l'issue des 12 mois de mission, une prolongation de 12 mois pourra être envisagée selon les résultats et les conditions applicables au dispositif V.I.E.
Les perspectives professionnelles à l'issue de la mission pourront également être étudiées en fonction des opportunités de Cahouet et du projet professionnel du/de la volontaire, en France comme à l'international.

Nous avons hâte de vous rencontrer !

246117.missionDescription:
Nous recherchons un Chef de projet - Electricity Planning pour rejoindre notre équipe ! 

Description du poste
Contexte
Vous rejoignez l'équipe qui développe un outil capable de décider, à chaque instant, s'il faut consommer, stocker ou réinjecter l'électricité d'un foyer ou d'une PME, n'importe où dans le monde.
Votre mission ? Concevoir et faire vivre l'API qui orchestre ces arbitrages en fonction des prix à la prise, partout dans le monde.
Nous recherchons un ingénieur, autonome, qui aime construire des systèmes propres et performants, et qui a envie de contribuer concrètement à la transition énergétique.
Missions du poste
Selectra recrute un ingénieur pour porter techniquement son projet Electricity Planning : une API d'arbitrage énergétique temps réel destinée aux particuliers et aux PME du monde entier.
Conception et architecture
Vous concevez l'architecture de l'API : modélisation des contrats énergétiques, des actifs pilotables (batteries, VE, PV, ballons d'eau chaude) et des stratégies d'arbitrage.
Vous arbitrez vous-même les choix techniques structurants : base relationnelle ou time-series, file d'attente, caching, déploiement.

Développement
Vous écrivez et maintenez le code Laravel qui calcule les arbitrages et expose l'API aux clients internes et partenaires intégrateurs.
Vous intégrez des sources de prix hétérogènes : prix spot, tarifs réglementés, tarifs dynamiques, contrats sur-mesure, dans des dizaines de pays.

Performance et fiabilité
Vous optimisez les temps de calcul et la scalabilité de l'API (Octane, Horizon, queues, parallélisation).
Vous mettez en place les tests, le monitoring et l'observabilité qui garantissent la qualité en production.

Évolution du produit
Vous documentez l'API et ses concepts métier pour les équipes internes et les intégrateurs.
Vous travaillez main dans la main avec l'équipe chargée de la saisie des données de prix, et avec les équipes produit qui définissent les nouveaux cas d'usage.
